name: Earth
label: Southern Lord
lede: Dylan Carlson slowed heavy metal to a crawl, made a 73-minute record with no drums, vanished for years, then came back playing western noir.

eras.title: A band named after Sabbath's old name
eras.text: Dylan Carlson starts Earth in Olympia with a plan: take heavy metal riffs, slow them to a crawl and hold them for as long as it takes. The early records are cheap, loud and stubbornly unmelodic.

years.src: Wikipedia: Earth (American band) · Red Bull Music Academy
years.h: [[Dylan Carlson|9383396d-12a6-44c2-9494-2f8df8776820]] starts Earth in Olympia
years.p: Carlson takes the name from Black Sabbath's pre-fame band and forms Earth with Slim Moon and Greg Babior. His stated influences run from minimalist composer La Monte Young to King Crimson and Slayer.
years.xp:
According to Wikipedia, Carlson chose the name Earth after the band Black Sabbath used before they were Black Sabbath. Slim Moon, later the founder of Kill Rock Stars, was in the first lineup.

The idea, as Carlson has described it, was to play metal riffs at half speed for an extended duration and use oblique motion: a fixed drone with other notes moving against it.

years.h: First recording session cost $300
years.p: Earth's first recording session, at Smegma Studios in Portland, was done on a shoestring budget according to Carlson. It became the raw first material for the band.

years.h: Extra-Capsular Extraction lands on Sub Pop
years.p: Earth's first release is the Extra-Capsular Extraction EP, a slab of feedback and low-end riffing. [[Kurt Cobain|3c9b356d-d1db-4f4e-a7a3-2d00c1d70255]], a friend of Carlson's, is reported to have screamed on it, per Seattle Weekly.

eras.title: The void at the heart of grunge
eras.text: While Seattle sells flannel to the world, Carlson makes a record with no drums, no vocals and three tracks that fill 73 minutes. Earth 2 becomes the blueprint for drone metal, and then the band slowly comes apart.

years.h: Earth 2 is recorded at Avast! in Seattle
years.p: Carlson and bassist Dave Harwell track the three songs with producer Stuart Hallerman. Joe Burns adds percussion on one track only.

q: Very claustrophobic, but I'm very glad people responded to it.
years.src: Wikipedia: Earth 2 · The Quietus · Distorted Sound
years.h: Earth 2: three tracks, 73 minutes, no drums
years.p: Sub Pop releases the album with tracks of 15, 27 and 30 minutes. AllMusic's John Bush wrote that it "virtually created" the drone and ambient metal subgenres.
years.xp:
The three tracks are "Seven Angels", "Teeth of Lions Rule the Divine" and "Like Gold and Faceted". Carlson told the press in 2018 he finds the record "very claustrophobic" but is glad people responded to it.

Stephen O'Malley later named a group Teeth of Lions Rule the Divine after the second track.

years.h: Sunn Amps and Smashed Guitars documents the live noise
years.p: Earth's live recordings from the period are collected on Sunn Amps and Smashed Guitars. A later reissue adds a demo, "Divine and Bright", with lead vocals by Kurt Cobain.

years.h: Dylan Carlson and Kurt Cobain's friendship ends in tragedy
years.p: Carlson, Cobain's close friend, bought a shotgun at Cobain's request days before Cobain died by suicide on April 5, per Wikipedia. Carlson later linked his heroin addiction to that period.
years.xp:
According to Wikipedia, on March 30, 1994 Cobain asked Carlson to buy a shotgun, saying it was for protection. Cobain used it six days later. Cobain had also sung on an Earth demo.

Carlson has said he struggled with heroin dependency, which intensified after Cobain's death, and now lives in recovery, per Wikipedia.

years.h: Phase 3: Thrones and Dominions
years.p: Earth's third record arrives during a stretch of ever-changing lineups and the start of Carlson's decline.

years.h: Pentastar: In the Style of Demons ends the first run
years.p: Earth's last record of the decade adds vocals and a riffy, rockier feel. It is followed by silence.

eras.title: From heroin to Hex
eras.text: Carlson disappears for years to addiction, rehab and legal trouble, and by his own account does not even own a guitar. When he returns, the band has slow country grooves and a real drummer.

years.src: Wikipedia: Dylan Carlson · Red Bull Music Academy
years.h: Carlson rebuilds Earth with Adrienne Davies
years.p: Earth returns with drummer Adrienne Davies, the first time live drums are a fixture. The band keeps the slowness but drops the noise wall.
years.xp:
Carlson credits legal and drug problems for the absence of full-length studio albums between 1997 and 2005, per Wikipedia. He lived in Los Angeles for about four years and did not play guitar, and resumed around 2001 to 2002.

Davies would become his musical partner for the rest of the band's history. Wikipedia notes the two were married and later separated, and she remains in Earth.

years.h: Live radio session on WNYC
years.p: Earth plays the WNYC station in New York, a sign of Carlson's return to public performance.

years.h: European tour with KK Null
years.p: Earth tours Europe with Japanese noise guitarist KK Null and records the Dexamyl material with Davies.

years.src: Wikipedia: Earth · Red Bull Music Academy · The Obelisk
years.h: Hex: Earth discovers Morricone and Duane Eddy
years.p: The first Earth album with Adrienne Davies on drums swaps distortion for twang, drawing on Duane Eddy, Merle Haggard and Ennio Morricone. It is the start of the "new Earth" on Southern Lord.
years.xp:
Carlson met [[Greg Anderson|a8da7651-6d6f-4021-98a6-d68b35b1e4f8]], founder of Southern Lord and a member of [[Sunn O)))|1d3da898-4fb4-4445-b704-cd7315e01789]], in Los Angeles around 2003. The Sunn O))) name itself is a tribute to Earth's love of Sunn amplifiers.

Hex became the template: long, spare western-noir instrumentals in which a single riff is stretched and shaded.
play: Hex: Or Printing in the Infernal Method

eras.title: Bill Frisell and the lion's skull
eras.text: With Southern Lord as home, Earth grows a proper band, brings in keys, upright bass and a jazz guitar hero, and makes a record that critics call a creative leap.

years.h: Hibernaculum re-records old Earth songs in country style
years.p: Except for "A Plague of Angels", every track is an older Earth song reworked in the Hex mold. It ships with a DVD documentary, Within the Drone, by Seldon Hunt.
years.xp: The band includes Don McGreevy on bass, Steve Moore on trombone and organ, and Greg Anderson on a Korg MS-20. Randall Dunn produces.

years.cap: The Bees Made Honey in the Lion's Skull, Southern Lord
years.src: Wikipedia: The Bees Made Honey in the Lion's Skull
years.h: Bill Frisell guests on The Bees Made Honey in the Lion's Skull
years.p: Randall Dunn produces at Avast and Aleph studios, with Steve Moore on piano and Hammond organ and Don McGreevy on bass. Jazz guitarist Bill Frisell plays on three tracks.
years.xp:
Reviews were strong: The Quietus gave it 9/10, Pitchfork 7.7 and The A.V. Club an A.

The record pulls in late 1960s San Francisco bands, jazz and film music.

eras.title: Cello, folk and a rock record
eras.text: Earth turns toward British folk-rock, adds Lori Goldston's cello and makes two Angels albums, then tightens up into something close to a rock band with singers.

years.cap: Angels of Darkness, Demons of Light I, Southern Lord
years.src: Wikipedia: Angels of Darkness, Demons of Light I · Wikipedia: Dylan Carlson
years.h: Angels I: cello and Pentangle-style folk
years.p: Recorded in April 2010, the album adds cellist [[Lori Goldston|279575ec-fe30-455f-adb1-7a627a0badba]] and bassist Karl Blau. Carlson called it more melodic and riff-oriented; it was recorded around a period when he was ill with hepatitis B.
years.xp:
Drew on British folk-rock acts Pentangle and Fairport Convention. Metacritic scored it 82.

Wikipedia says Carlson survived a rare hepatitis B infection and liver failure.

years.h: Angels II: the improvised sequel
years.p: Recorded already by the time Part I appeared, it leans on improvisation.

years.h: Primitive and Deadly lets Earth be a rock band
years.p: Mark Lanegan sings on two tracks and Rabia Shaheen Qazi on one, on Earth's first record with voices since Pentastar.
years.xp: Recorded at Rancho de la Luna in Joshua Tree and at Avast in Seattle with producer Randall Dunn. Bill Herzog plays bass, with guitarists Brett Netson and Jodie Cox. The band said it let itself be a rock band.

eras.title: Desert concrete and a new label
eras.text: Earth keeps grinding on, teaming with dub producer The Bug and switching to Sargent House.

years.h: Concrete Desert with The Bug
years.p: Earth and Kevin Martin's The Bug release the collaborative Concrete Desert.

years.src: Wikipedia: Full Upon Her Burning Lips
years.h: Full Upon Her Burning Lips on Sargent House
years.p: The ninth studio album arrives with a US tour supporting it, opening act Helms Alee.
years.xp: The lead single was "Cats on the Briar" (March 6, 2019). It ran 62 minutes across ten tracks.

years.h: Bologna show canceled over a Palestinian flag
years.p: Earth pulled a show at TPO social centre in Bologna just before playing, objecting to a flag; Wikipedia says the venue lost about 5,000 euros and started a crowdfunding campaign.
